verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation addresses workspace scale limits, item/block caps, or performance guarantees for large databases; the evidence pack only contains generic API/marketplace docs and unrelated integration listings. Community reports (notion-comm-4, notion-comm-8, notion-comm-13, notion-comm-17) even describe hitting a hard 1000-block limit and persistent sluggishness/data loss, but these are anecdotal complaints, not an official statement Notion could be shown contradicting, so this doesn't rise to 'disputed' — it simply lacks any vendor evidence of delivering predictable performance at tens-of-thousands-of-tasks scale.
